description: This Java class 'SchedulerApiResource' provides REST API endpoints for retrieving and controlling the scheduler status within the Fineract platform. It handles GET requests to check if the scheduler is active and POST requests to start or stop the scheduler, with appropriate permission checks. The class uses JAX-RS annotations for resource mapping, Swagger annotations for documentation, and relies on injected services for security and scheduler management.

classes.name: SchedulerApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing API endpoints to retrieve scheduler status and control the scheduler (start/stop) in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveStatus
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve current scheduler status. Checks user permission, queries scheduler state, and returns details as JSON.

methods.name: changeSchedulerStatus
methods.description: Handles POST requests to change scheduler state (start or stop). Performs permission checks, interprets command parameter, and invokes scheduler service accordingly.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Helper method to compare command parameter with expected command strings in a case-insensitive manner.
